sample_variants_from_vae: sample variants of an aligned parent sequence from a VAE model using homolog config
rejection_sample: run a generic rejection sampler with a sample function and feasibility filter to accept valid samples
sample_latents_from_posterior: sample latents from the VAE posterior distribution given a parent sequence
sample_structures_from_latents: sample protein structures from latent representations produced by the VAE
sample_int_variant_batch_from_vae: sample integer-encoded variant sequences from a VAE given a parent sequence batch
